verdict.rationale: Conductor documents a REST-style API for managing cloud workspaces (conductor-docs-13) and a hosted MCP server for MCP clients to manage cloud workspaces (conductor-docs-14, conductor-probe-4), showing genuine API-driven control. However, no OpenAPI spec is discoverable (conductor-probe-3: all candidate paths 404), and the API appears scoped to cloud workspace management only, not the full UI surface (local workspaces, loadouts/model switching, routines, collaboration/reassignment, checkpoints, port forwarding) which have no documented API equivalents. missing for 10: full API/OpenAPI spec coverage confirming parity with all UI features (local workspace ops, loadouts, routines, collaboration actions, checkpoints), independent confirmation of API completeness.
